values: 开场召唤长矛花灵助战，主动使用时召唤大锤花灵造成范围伤害。
Summons Spiny when a battle starts. When actively used, summons Smashy and deals AoE damage.

战斗开始时，召唤长矛花灵“淘淘”协助作战。淘淘继承自身80% + 15%最大生命值，普通攻击造成自身60% ATK伤害。当淘淘被击败时会回到豆荚中休息，并在10秒后自动复活。
主动使用时，选择一个格子，在该位置召唤大锤花灵“困困”并重击地面，对周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成300% ATK伤害和击飞效果。困困继承自身220%最大生命值，普通攻击造成自身120% ATK伤害。当困困受到控制效果影响时，其受到的一切伤害提高100%。
困困在场时再次使用该技能，将为困困清除负面状态并回复至满血，并使困困前往所选位置再次重击地面。

Florabelle summons Spiny when a battle starts. Spiny inherits 80% + 15% of Florabelle's Max HP, dealing 60% ATK damage with normal attacks. Spiny retreats to the pod when defeated, then rejoins the battle after 10s.
Active. Florabelle selects a tile to summon Smashy to smash the ground, dealing 300% ATK damage to all adjacent enemies and knocking them into the air. Smashy inherits 220% of Florabelle's Max HP, dealing 120% ATK damage with normal attacks. Smashy takes 100% extra damage when under control effects.
Florabelle casts the skill to remove all debuffs on Smashy and restore its HP to full, commanding Smashy to smash the target area ground again.
淘淘的普通攻击伤害提升至70% ATK。
Increases Spiny's normal attack damage to 70% ATK.
召唤大锤花灵“困困”时，若此时全部三名花灵均已在场上，则效果改为由全体花灵共同发动一次连携攻击，对半径3格范围内的所有敌人造成400% ATK伤害和击飞效果。

When all three Bulbsprites are on the battlefield, summoning Smashy will instead trigger a coordinated attack from all Bulbsprites, dealing 400% ATK damage to all enemies within 3 tiles and knocking them into the air.
淘淘的普通攻击伤害提升至80% ATK。
Increases Spiny's normal attack damage to 80% ATK.
大锤花灵“困困”的普通攻击伤害提升至220% ATK。
Increases Smashy's normal attack damage to 220% ATK.
使一名友方花灵巨大化，提升急速和生命汲取。
Transforms a Bulbsprite into a giant, increasing their Haste and Life Drain.
向一名友方花灵投喂花竹果，使其巨大化，持续8秒。花灵在巨大化期间获得额外60 + 6点急速和60点生命汲取。当场上同时存在多名友方花灵时，本技能会按照困困、乐乐、淘淘的顺序选择释放目标。

Florabelle feeds a Bulbsprite with petalplum to transform them into a giant for 8s. Giant Bulbsprites will gain an extra 60 + 6 Haste and 60 Life Drain. When multiple Bulbsprites are on the field, this skill targets them in the order of Smashy, Swifty, and Spiny.
巨大化期间获得的生命汲取提高至80点。
Increases Life Drain in giant form to 80.
巨大化期间获得的生命汲取提高至100点。
Increases Life Drain in giant form to 100.
巨大化的持续时间延长至10秒。
Increases the duration of the giant form to 10s.
召唤拥有远程能力的短弓花灵助战。
Summons a ranged Bulbsprite into battle.
在自己身后召唤短弓花灵“乐乐”协助作战。乐乐拥有6格射程，继承自身45%最大生命值，普通攻击造成自身80% + 10% ATK伤害。当乐乐已在场上时，本技能效果改为令其进行一次“短弓乱射”，随机发射8支箭攻击场上敌人，每支箭造成70% ATK伤害。乐乐被击败后8秒内无法再次将其召唤。

Florabelle summons Swifty in the back. Swifty has a 6-tile attack range, inherits 45% of Florabelle's Max HP, and deals 80% + 10% ATK damage with normal attacks. Casting this skill while Swifty is already on the battlefield initiates Swifty's Rapid Fire, unleashing 8 arrows at random targets, each dealing 70% ATK damage. Swifty cannot be summoned again for the next 8s after being defeated.
乐乐的普通攻击伤害提高至95% + 10% ATK。
Increases Swifty's normal attack damage to 95% + 10% ATK.
乐乐进行“短弓乱射”时，每支箭造成的伤害提高至88% ATK。
Increases the damage of each arrow to 88% ATK when Swifty casts Rapid Fire.
乐乐的普通攻击伤害提高至110% + 10% ATK。
Increases Swifty's normal attack damage to 110% + 10% ATK.
提高自身攻击力，场上存在至少2个自身召唤物时进一步提升攻击力。
Florabelle's ATK increases during battle, and it further increases when at least 2 of her summons are on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高10%攻击力。当场上至少存在2个自身的召唤物时，自身额外提升4%攻击力。
Florabelle increases her ATK by 10% during battle. She gains an extra 4% ATK when at least 2 of her summons are on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高14%攻击力。当场上至少存在2个自身的召唤物时，自身额外提升6%攻击力。
Florabelle increases her ATK by 14% during battle. She gains an extra 6% ATK when at least 2 of her summons are on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高18%攻击力。当场上至少存在2个自身的召唤物时，自身额外提升8%攻击力。
Florabelle increases her ATK by 18% during battle. She gains an extra 8% ATK when at least 2 of her summons are on the battlefield.
友方召唤物被召唤时，为其施加永久护盾。
Grants a permanent shield to an allied summon when it enters the battlefield.
每当一名友方召唤物被召唤，芙拉贝尔会对其施加自然祝福，使其获得一个相当于自身攻击力280%的永久护盾。
Grants a Natural Blessing to allied summons upon their entrance to the battlefield, providing them with a permanent shield capable of absorbing damage equal to 280% of Florabelle's ATK.
本技能施加的护盾值提高至自身攻击力的330%。
Boosts the shield granted by this skill to 330% of Florabell's ATK.
当芙拉贝尔释放技能“过量施肥”时，若场上存在花灵以外的其他友方召唤物，则同时会对其中攻击力最高的一名友方召唤物投喂一颗弱化版的花竹果，使其在巨大化的持续期间内获得27点急速和32点生命汲取。
Feeds the allied summon with the highest ATK with an unripe petalplum when Florabelle casts Overgrowth. This transforms the summon into a giant, increasing their Haste by 27 and Life Drain by 32.
本技能施加的护盾值提高至自身攻击力的350%。
Boosts the shield granted by this skill to 350% of Florabell's ATK.
友方花灵在巨大化期间免疫控制效果。
Allied Bulbsprite in their giant form are immune to control effects.
友方花灵在巨大化期间免疫控制效果。
Allied Bulbsprite in their giant form are immune to control effects.
技能“过量施肥”冷却时间降低至5秒，并会同时对困困、乐乐、淘淘释放，巨大化期间召唤物额外提升等同于芙拉贝尔40% ATK的攻击力。
Overgrowth has its cooldown reduced to 5s and can simultaneously affect Smashy, Swifty, and Spiny. Meanwhile, allied summons in their giant form gain extra ATK equal to 40% ATK.
